clusters.title: [Suggestion] Feature Request: Native Shevery API support
clusters.summary: ### Suggestion Hello! Could you please add native support for the Shevery API (com.hamondev.shevery) alongside Shizuku? Shevery is now using its own native provider, and adding native support would allow the app to work seamlessly without needing compatibility stubs. Thanks!
